abstract: Three-dimensional traction force microscopy (3DTFM) in fibrillar hydrogels typically models the extracellular matrix as a continuum. We present data-driven 3DTFM (DD-TFM), which reconstructs fiber networks from confocal images and models them as discrete fiber networks mechanically calibrated by shear rheology. We validate DD-TFM in silico and apply it to endothelial cells, quantifying cell-generated forces and matrix stresses at the fiber level. Compared with continuum TFM DD-TFM reveals network-guided matrix deformations, shifting 3DTFM toward fiber-resolved force calculation.
